chunks: The Jews and Christians will never be pleased with you until you follow their way. Say: 'God's guidance alone is true guidance;' for if you give in to their wishes after having received the (Book of) knowledge from God, then none will you have as friend or helper to save you.
ai.seo_question: Why won't Jews and Christians be pleased with the Prophet until he follows their way?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse highlights the theological principle that true guidance (Huda) is exclusive to divine revelation, contrasting it with the subjective desires (Ahwa') of other communities. It serves as a warning to the Prophet (SAW) against compromising core tenets for political or social appeasement, emphasizing that adherence to God's will supersedes external validation. The mention of 'after the knowledge came to you' underscores the finality and completeness of the prophetic message.
